newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac says train blast barbaric, terrorist act.
newsitem.headline: Chirac says train blast barbaric, terrorist act.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac condemned a Paris train station bombing on Tuesday as a "barbaric and terrorist act" and pledged to use all means to fight terrorism.
"This is without doubt a barbaric and terrorist act," Chirac said in a live television address after the blast killed two people at the Port Royal station in the capital.

"Faced with such unacceptable and barbaric acts against innocent people, I would like to state...my determination, that of the government and that of the whole nation to fight by all means against all forms of terrorism," Chirac said.
Two people were killed and 47 injured, eight of them seriously, in the explosion on an underground railway train.
The explosion occurred in the fourth carriage of the RER train at 6.05 p.m. (1705 GMT) at the Port Royal station on the Left Bank, the RATP transport authority said.
Prime Minister Alain Juppe said an explosive device caused the blast and ordered the "Vigipirate" anti-terrorism security plan relaunched.
